title: A randomized controlled trial to analyze the effects of an App-based patient education textbook (Ready4OP App) to increase health literacy before major oncologic surgery and its potential effects on surgical outcomes in Sweden, Slovenia, Spain, and Germany. The APERIO trial.
summary: In Aperio wird die Möglichkeit der Verbesserung der Gesundheitskompetenz bezüglich Wissen zu großen Operationen und oprimale Vorbereitung durch eine digitale Intervention untersucht und der Einfluss auf das postoperative Ergebnis ermittelt.

interventions.name: Intervention with a specific patient education tool about preoperative optimization

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Written informed consent
2. Willing to participate
3. Patients before major surgical oncologic procedures*
4. Patients having a smartphone with Android or iOS
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients younger than 18 years
2. Women that are anamnestically pregnant
3. Patients unable to understand the rationale of the study
4. Patients unable to interact with the application
5. Patients with a planned palliative oncologic surgery
6. Patients with an ECOG performance status of 3 or higher
7. Patients with mental impairment leading to inability to cooperate
8. Patients under guardianship or imprisoned
